jobs.title: Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 114,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

Abbott Established Pharmaceutical Division (EPD) is looking for a
Cloud Architect
for its global Pharma Division Headquarter based in Allschwil- Basel.

Primary Job Function:

The AA team is on a mission to reshape the entire EPD division around data-driven decision-making. The Cloud Architect collaborates closely with our Data Science team and our product delivery team to make sure that the applications we deploy are built on scalable and robust technology stack. These solutions directly transform the way we produce market and sell our products around the world.

This role focuses on designing and implementing cloud architectures that run AI/GenAI applications in a scalable way across multiple platforms (mobile, web etc..) used by our stakeholders around the world. You help our Engineering team to streamline or automate cloud infrastructure deployment, to enable other development teams to develop and deploy faster focusing on the application core.

Core Job Responsibilities:

Cloud Solution Architecture:

• Design and build, and maintain cloud architectures for scalable, robust AI/GenAI applications across platforms (web, mobile, desktop).

• Leverage cloud-native services to ensure optimal performance, availability, security, and cost efficiency.

• Monitor and optimize cloud infrastructure for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency, leveraging cloud-native monitoring and alerting tools.

• Design and implement load balancing, auto-scaling, and failover strategies to guarantee high availability across all deployed applications.

• Document reference architectures, technical roadmaps, and conduct design reviews with engineering and product teams.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation:

• Develop and maintain infrastructure as code (IaC) frameworks and automated workflows, making cloud deployment accessible to developers regardless of IaC expertise.

• Implement robust monitoring, security guardrails, and compliance checks to ensure infrastructure changes are safe, reliable, and aligned with production standards.

Security, Compliance, and Reliability:

• Champion secure cloud designs, ensuring compliance with data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements in coordination with our security team.

• Establish observability, monitoring and disaster recovery mechanisms for all AI/GenAI workloads.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• 8+ years of experience architecting and delivering cloud-native applications, including at least 3 years specializing in AI/ML or GenAI workloads.

• Demonstrated experience with monitoring, optimizing, and troubleshooting cloud infrastructure for performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency using modern observability tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Prometheus, Datadog).

• Expertise in AWS cloud services (e.g., ECS, EKS, Lambda, SageMaker, S3, IAM, VPC, Cognito, Step Functions, CloudWatch)

• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, OpenTofu) and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, OPA, containerization with Docker/Kubernetes).

• AWS Certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer etc..) a plus.

• Full stack experience a plus.

• Experience supporting global deployments of multi-platform applications (web, mobile, desktop) across geographies (CDN).

• Proven communication skills. Fluency in English a must.

• Passion for transforming organizations through large scale data

Do you like the sound of this job and think you’ve got what it takes? Then send us your CV today. We look forward to receiving your application as pdf .

(

DESCRIZIONE: Abbott è un leader sanitario globale che aiuta le persone a vivere più pienamente in tutte le fasi della vita. Il nostro portafoglio di tecnologie che cambiano la vita abbraccia lo spettro della salute, con aziende leader e prodotti nella diagnostica, dispositivi medici, nutrizioni e farmaci generici di marca. I nostri 114.000 colleghi servono persone in oltre 160 paesi. Abbott Stabilito Divisione Farmaceutica (EPD) sta cercando un Cloud Architect per il suo quartier generale della Divisione Farmacia globale con sede a Allschwil- Basel. Funzione di lavoro primario: Il team AA è in missione per rimodellare l'intera divisione EPD attorno al processo decisionale basato sui dati. Il Cloud Architect collabora a stretto contatto con il nostro team Data Science e con il nostro team di consegna prodotti per assicurarsi che le applicazioni che distribuiamo siano costruite su uno stack di tecnologia scalabile e robusto. Queste soluzioni trasformano direttamente il modo in cui produciamo mercato e vendiamo i nostri prodotti in tutto il mondo. Questo ruolo si concentra sulla progettazione e l'implementazione di architetture cloud che gestiscono applicazioni AI/GenAI in modo scalabile attraverso piattaforme multiple (mobile, web ecc.) utilizzate dai nostri stakeholder in tutto il mondo. Aiutate il nostro team Engineering a semplificare o automatizzare la distribuzione delle infrastrutture cloud, per consentire ad altri team di sviluppo di sviluppare e distribuire più velocemente concentrandosi sul core dell'applicazione. Responsabilità del lavoro: Cloud Solution Architecture:
• Progettare e costruire e mantenere architetture cloud per applicazioni AI/GenAI scalabili e robuste su piattaforme (web, mobile, desktop).
• Servizi cloud-native per garantire prestazioni ottimali, disponibilità, sicurezza e efficienza dei costi.
• Monitorare e ottimizzare l'infrastruttura cloud per la latenza, il throughput e l'efficienza dei costi, sfruttando strumenti di monitoraggio e allerta cloud-native.
• Progettare e implementare strategie di bilanciamento del carico, auto-scaling e failover per garantire elevata disponibilità in tutte le applicazioni impiegate.
• Architetture di riferimento del documento, roadmap tecniche e condurre recensioni di progettazione con team di ingegneria e prodotto. Infrastrutture come Code & Automation:
• Sviluppare e mantenere l'infrastruttura come framework code (IaC) e flussi di lavoro automatizzati, rendendo l'implementazione cloud accessibile agli sviluppatori indipendentemente dalla competenza IaC.
• Implementare controlli robusti, controlli di sicurezza e controlli di conformità per garantire che i cambiamenti delle infrastrutture siano sicuri, affidabili e allineati agli standard di produzione. Sicurezza, conformità e affidabilità:
• Campione design cloud sicuro, garantendo il rispetto della privacy dei dati, della sicurezza e dei requisiti normativi in coordinamento con il nostro team di sicurezza.
• Stabilire meccanismi di osservazione, monitoraggio e ripristino dei disastri per tutti i carichi di lavoro AI/GenAI. Preferiti:
• Laurea o Master in Informatica, Ingegneria, o una disciplina relativa.
• 8+ anni di esperienza di progettazione e fornitura di applicazioni cloud-native, tra cui almeno 3 anni specializzandosi nei carichi di lavoro AI/ML o GenAI.
• Esperienza dimostrata con monitoraggio, ottimizzazione e risoluzione dei problemi delle infrastrutture cloud per prestazioni, affidabilità e efficienza dei costi utilizzando strumenti di osservabilità moderni (ad esempio CloudWatch, Prometheus, Datadog).
• Competenza nei servizi cloud AWS (ad esempio, ECS, EKS, Lambda, SageMaker, S3, IAM, VPC, Cognito, Step Functions, CloudWatch)
• Proficienza in Infrastrutture come Codice (Terraform, CloudFormation, OpenTofu) e moderne pratiche DevOps (CI/CD, OPA, containerizzazione con Docker/Kubernetes).
• Certificazione AWS (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer ecc.) un plus.
• Piena esperienza stack un plus.
• Esperienza di supporto alle implementazioni globali di applicazioni multi-piattaforma (web, mobile, desktop) attraverso geografie (CDN).
• Prove capacità di comunicazione. Fluenza in inglese un must.
• Passione per trasformare le organizzazioni attraverso dati su larga scala Ti piace il suono di questo lavoro e pensi di avere quello che serve? Allora mandaci il tuo CV oggi. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura come pdf . (

BESCHREIBUNG: Abbott ist ein globaler Gesundheitsführer, der Menschen hilft, in allen Lebensphasen vollständiger zu leben. Unser Portfolio an lebensverändernden Technologien umfasst das Spektrum der Gesundheitsversorgung, mit führenden Unternehmen und Produkten in Diagnostik, Medizinprodukten, Ernährungs- und Markenmedizin. Unsere 114.000 Kollegen dienen Menschen in mehr als 160 Ländern. Abbott Established Pharmaceutical Division (EPD) sucht eine Architektur und Architektur für sein weltweites Pharma Division Headquarter mit Sitz in Allschwil- Basel. Primary Job Funktion: Das AA-Team ist auf der Mission, die gesamte EPD-Division um datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung umzugestalten. Der Cloud Architect arbeitet eng mit unserem Data Science Team und unserem Produktlieferteam zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die von uns bereitgestellten Anwendungen auf skalierbaren und robusten Technologiestapeln basieren. Diese Lösungen verwandeln direkt die Art und Weise, wie wir unsere Produkte weltweit produzieren und verkaufen. Diese Rolle konzentriert sich auf die Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Cloud-Architekturen, die KI/GenAI-Anwendungen auf skalierbare Weise über mehrere Plattformen (Mobile, Web etc.) führen, die von unseren Stakeholdern weltweit genutzt werden. Sie helfen unserem Engineering-Team, die Cloud-Infrastruktur-Bereitstellung zu optimieren oder zu automatisieren, um anderen Entwicklungsteams die Entwicklung und den Einsatz schneller auf den Anwendungskern zu ermöglichen. Core Job Responsibilities: Cloud Solution Architecture:
• Entwicklung und Aufbau von Cloud-Architekturen für skalierbare, robuste AI/GenAI-Anwendungen auf Plattformen (Web, Mobile, Desktop).
• Nutzen Sie Cloud-Native Services, um optimale Leistung, Verfügbarkeit, Sicherheit und Kosteneffizienz zu gewährleisten.
• Überwachen und optimieren Sie die Cloud-Infrastruktur für Latenz, Durchsatz und Kosteneffizienz, nutzen Sie Cloud-native Überwachungs- und Alarmierungstools.
• Entwerfen und implementieren Sie Lastausgleich, Auto-Skalierung und Failover-Strategien, um eine hohe Verfügbarkeit in allen eingesetzten Anwendungen zu gewährleisten.
• Dokumentenreferenzarchitekturen, technische Roadmaps und führen Designrezensionen mit Ingenieur- und Produktteams durch. Infrastruktur als Code & Automation:
• Entwicklung und Aufrechterhaltung der Infrastruktur als Code (IaC)-Frameworks und automatisierte Workflows, wodurch Cloud-Bereitstellung unabhängig von IaC-Expertise für Entwickler zugänglich ist.
• Ergänzen Sie robuste Überwachungs-, Sicherheits- und Compliance-Kontrollen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Infrastrukturänderungen sicher, zuverlässig und mit den Produktionsstandards konform sind. Sicherheit, Compliance und Zuverlässigkeit:
• Champion sichere Cloud-Designs, um die Einhaltung der Datenschutz-, Sicherheits- und regulatorischen Anforderungen in Abstimmung mit unserem Sicherheitsteam zu gewährleisten.
• Einrichtung von Beobachtungs-, Überwachungs- und Katastrophenrückgewinnungsmechanismen für alle AI/GenAI-Workloads. Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:
• Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder einer verwandten Disziplin.
• 8+ Jahre Erfahrung Architekt und Bereitstellung von Cloud-Native Anwendungen, einschließlich mindestens 3 Jahre spezialisiert auf AI/ML oder GenAI Workloads.
• Demonstrierte Erfahrung mit der Überwachung, Optimierung und Fehlerbehebung der Cloud-Infrastruktur für Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz mittels moderner Beobachtungstools (z.B. CloudWatch, Prometheus, Datadog).
• Expertise in AWS Cloud Services (z.B. ECS, EKS, Lambda, SageMaker, S3, IAM, VPC, Cognito, Step Functions, CloudWatch)
• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, OpenTofu) und moderne DevOps Praktiken (CI/CD, OPA, Containerisierung mit Docker/Kubernetes).
• AWS-Zertifizierung (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer etc.).
• Vollständige Stack-Erfahrung ein Plus.
• Erleben Sie die Unterstützung globaler Bereitstellungen von Multi-Plattform-Anwendungen (Web, Mobile, Desktop) über Geographien (CDN).
• Bewährte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Fluency in English a must.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
DESCRIPTION DE L'EMPLOI : Abbott est un leader mondial des soins de santé qui aide les gens à vivre plus pleinement à tous les stades de la vie. Notre portefeuille de technologies qui changent la vie couvre le spectre des soins de santé, avec des entreprises et des produits de premier plan dans le diagnostic, les dispositifs médicaux, la nutrition et les médicaments génériques de marque. Nos 114 000 collègues servent des gens dans plus de 160 pays. Abbott La Division pharmaceutique établie (DPE) cherche Architecte Cloud pour son siège mondial de la division Pharma basé à Allschwil-Bâle. Fonction principale : L'équipe AA est en mission de remodeler l'ensemble de la division EPD autour de la prise de décision axée sur les données. Le Cloud Architect collabore étroitement avec notre équipe Data Science et notre équipe de livraison de produits pour s'assurer que les applications que nous déployons sont construites sur une pile technologique évolutive et robuste. Ces solutions transforment directement la façon dont nous produisons le marché et vendons nos produits partout dans le monde. Ce rôle est axé sur la conception et la mise en œuvre d'architectures cloud qui gèrent les applications AI/GenAI de manière évolutive sur plusieurs plateformes (mobile, web, etc.) utilisées par nos parties prenantes à travers le monde. Vous aidez notre équipe d'ingénierie à rationaliser ou automatiser le déploiement de l'infrastructure cloud, afin de permettre à d'autres équipes de développement de se développer et de déployer plus rapidement en se concentrant sur le noyau d'application. Responsabilités essentielles au travail : Architecture des solutions en nuage :
• Concevoir et construire des architectures cloud pour des applications AI/GenAI évolutives et robustes sur toutes les plateformes (web, mobile, bureau).
• Tirer parti des services cloud-native pour assurer des performances optimales, disponibilité, sécurité et rentabilité.
• Surveiller et optimiser l'infrastructure cloud pour la latence, le débit et le rapport coût-efficacité, en tirant parti des outils de surveillance et d'alerte cloud-native.
• Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies d'équilibrage des charges, d'auto-échelle et de basculement pour garantir une grande disponibilité dans toutes les applications déployées.
• Documenter les architectures de référence, les feuilles de route techniques et effectuer des examens de conception avec les équipes d'ingénierie et de produits. Infrastructure comme code et automatisation :
• Développer et maintenir l'infrastructure en tant que cadres de code (IaC) et flux de travail automatisés, rendant le déploiement en nuage accessible aux développeurs, indépendamment de l'expertise IaC.
• Mettre en oeuvre une surveillance robuste, des garde-corps de sécurité et des contrôles de conformité pour s'assurer que les changements d'infrastructure sont sûrs, fiables et conformes aux normes de production. Sécurité, conformité et fiabilité :
• Des conceptions cloud sécurisées championnes, garantissant le respect de la confidentialité des données, de la sécurité et des exigences réglementaires en coordination avec notre équipe de sécurité.
• Mettre en place des mécanismes d'observation, de suivi et de reprise après sinistre pour toutes les charges de travail de l'IA/GenAI. Qualifications préférées :
• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, ingénierie ou discipline connexe.
• 8 ans et plus d'expérience dans l'architecture et la fourniture d'applications cloud-native, y compris au moins 3 ans spécialisés dans les tâches AI/ML ou GenAI.
• Expérience démontrée en matière de surveillance, d'optimisation et de dépannage de l'infrastructure cloud pour la performance, la fiabilité et la rentabilité grâce à des outils modernes d'observation (par exemple CloudWatch, Prometheus, Datadog).
• Expertise en services cloud AWS (par exemple, ECS, EKS, Lambda, SageMaker, S3, IAM, VPC, Cognito, Step Functions, CloudWatch)
• Compétence en infrastructure comme code (Terraform, CloudFormation, OpenTofu) et pratiques DevOps modernes (CI/CD, OPA, conteneurisation avec Docker/Kubernetes).
• AWS Certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, etc.) a plus.
• Pleine expérience de pile un plus.
• Expérience de soutien aux déploiements mondiaux d'applications multiplateformes (web, mobile, bureautique) à travers les géographies (CDN).
• Compétences éprouvées en communication. La fluidité en anglais un must.
• La passion pour la transformation des organisations au moyen de données à grande échelle Vous aimez le son de ce travail et pensez que vous avez ce qu'il faut ? Alors envoyez-nous votre CV aujourd'hui. Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre demande en format pdf . (

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Abbott ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Gesundheitswesen, das bahnbrechende wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse nutzt und Lösungen zur Verbesserung der Gesundheit der Menschen entwickelt. Wir blicken stets in die Zukunft und antizipieren Veränderungen in der medizinischen Wissenschaft und Technologie.

ARBEITEN BEI ABBOTT

Bei Abbott finden Sie eine Aufgabe, die von Bedeutung ist, und können sich weiterentwickeln und lernen, für sich und Ihre Familie sorgen, sich selbst verwirklichen und ein erfülltes Leben führen. Abbott bietet Ihnen:

• Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem internationalen Unternehmen, in dem Sie die Karriere machen können, von der Sie träumen

• Eine herausfordernde Position in einer schnell wachsenden krisenunabhängigen Branche

• Teil eines dynamischen, hochqualifizierten und motivierten Teams zu werden

• Flache Hierarchien, offene, wertschätzende Mentalität und effiziente, konstruktive Kommunikationswege

• Ein multinationales Umfeld, in dem wir die Entwicklung unserer Talente innerhalb des Unternehmens fördern

• Ein Unternehmen, das als eine der Best Big Companies to Work For  anerkannt ist, sowie als bester Arbeitsplatz für Vielfalt, arbeitende Mütter, weibliche Führungskräfte und Wissenschaftler:innen sowie als Top Employer Deutschlands ausgezeichnet wurde

Bei Abbott Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) entwickeln wir umfassende, effektive und kosteneffiziente Lösungen für die Steuerung und Behandlung von Herzrhythmus-Störungen.

Zur Stärkung des Schweizer Vertriebsteams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n

Regional Sales Manager Cardiac Rhythm Management - Region Zentralschweiz
home-office based, idealer Wohnort im Raum Aarau, Basel, Bern, Luzern

In Abstimmung mit dem Country Manager hat der Regional Sales Manager selbstständig eine vorgegebene Region zu bearbeiten. Dazu gehört die Führung eines eigenen Verkaufsgebietes, die Akquisition von Kunden, die Betreuung der vorhandenen Kunden, die Initiierung von Ausbildung in den Kundenhäusern, die gezielte Information von Nichtkunden, das sorgfältige Überprüfen der gesamten Region nach möglichen Kunden sowie die Weitergabe dieser Informationen an das Unternehmen. Darüber hinaus übernimmt er die Vertriebsplanung und die Aufstellung von Verkaufsplänen für die jeweilige Region. Des Weiteren ist er für die Führung eines Vertriebs- und Technikerteams und die Steuerung sämtlicher Aktivitäten zuständig.

​ IHRE AUFGABEN

• Verkaufs- und Führungsverantwortung

• Verantwortung für das Erreichen der Budgetziele in der Region mit den vorgegebenen Produktgruppen und seinem Team

• Sicherstellung des höchstmöglichen Umsatzvolums, bei bestmöglicher Marge

• Erweiterung des Marktanteils

• Verantwortlich für inventory management und Opex Control

• Erhebt und überwacht ständig die Anzahl aller potentiellen Kunden im Vertriebsgebiet

• Erfragt und verifiziert Wettbewerbskonditionen für vergleichbare Produkte und Dienstleistungen

• Erstellt auf dieser Basis und weiteren Vorgaben prospektive Absatz- und Umsatzplanungen

• Kommuniziert Marktdaten und Planung mit den Mitarbeitern sowie übergeordnetem Management

• Verschafft sich ein von Vertriebsmitarbeitern unabhängiges Bild vom Markt

• Positioniert Abbott Medical als langfristigen, strategischen Partner im rhythmologischen Produktsegment

​ IHR PROFIL

• Grundeinstellung: Chancendenker und motivierte Vertriebspersönlichkeit idealerweise mit Erfahrung im Umfeld erklärungsbedürftiger Medizinprodukte

• Ein abgeschlossenes naturwissenschaftliches, technisches oder wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Idealerweise Vertriebs- oder Marketingerfahrung im kardiovaskulären Marktumfeld

• Sie beherrschen die Umgebung des Operationssaals / Katheterlabors

• Hohes analytisches Verständnis, strategisches Denkvermögen und Belastbarkeit

• Freundlichkeit, Teamfähigkeit sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit

• Flexibilität, Anpassungsfähigkeit und ein positiver U

Descrizione Abbott è leader mondiale nella sanità, che utilizza le conoscenze scientifiche innovative e sviluppa soluzioni per migliorare la salute umana. Guardiamo sempre al futuro e aspettiamo i cambiamenti nella scienza medica e nella tecnologia. jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Global Medical Director – Cardiometabolic

Abbott | Established Pharmaceutical Division

About Abbott

At Abbott , we believe people live their fullest lives when they are healthy — physically, emotionally, and socially . As a global healthcare leader with more than 107,000 colleagues across 160+ countries , we develop life‑changing medicines and technologies that support health at every stage of life.

Within our Branded Generics business, we make trusted, high‑quality medicines accessible to more than 18 million people every day , particularly in fast‑growing regions such as LATAM, APAC, India, and Emerging Markets . Our diverse portfolio spans critical therapeutic areas including Women’s Health, Gastroenterology, Cardiometabolic, CNS & Pain, and Respiratory , addressing real and often unmet patient needs worldwide.

Abbott is a place where science, purpose, and people come together — and where diverse perspectives, inclusive leadership, and collaboration are essential to building better outcomes for patients.
Your Impact

As Global Medical Director – Cardiometabolic , you will play a pivotal role in shaping Abbott’s global medical strategy for the Cardiometabolic therapeutic area. Working as a trusted partner across functions, you will help define both short‑ and long‑term direction , ensuring that medical decision‑making remains scientifically rigorous, patient‑focused, and globally aligned.

You will be a core member of the Medical Affairs Leadership Team within the Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD), contributing your expertise and perspective to key strategic decisions across Medical Affairs, Innovation & Development.

What You Will Do

Medical Strategy & Scientific Leadership

• Lead the global medical strategy and activities for the Cardiometabolic therapeutic area and assigned products

• Collaborate closely with cross‑functional partners to translate scientific insight into meaningful medical and patient impact

• Identify unmet medical needs and mid‑ to long‑term opportunities for differentiation, innovation, and value creation

• Continuously evaluate products within scope, identifying portfolio gap‑filling opportunities , including in‑licensing considerations

• Develop therapeutic area medical plans , integrating research priorities, publication strategies, real‑world evidence, and study initiatives

• Prepare Target Product Profiles (TPPs) in partnership with cross‑functional teams

Evidence Generation & Governance

• Lead and govern Global Medical Affairs research projects , including IIS, post‑marketing studies, observational and epidemiologic research, Phase IV and RWE studies

• Serve as Chair of the Scientific Review Committee for GMA‑led clinical research activities

• Jointly review and approve clinical activities led by Clinical Development teams

• Drive high‑quality scientific content for digital initiatives aimed at both HCPs and patients

Collaboration, Safety & Compliance

• Build and sustain strong collaboration with regional and local Medical Directors , ensuring alignment between global strategy and local execution

• Establish and maintain trusted, ethical relationships with Key Opinion Leaders and scientific societies

• Act as a core member of the Product Safety Team , overseeing medical safety monitoring and contributing to PSURs, clinical overviews, and risk management plans

• As part of the Labeling Sub‑Team , provide medical input and scientific strategies for global and national label changes, including safety‑related updates

• Ensure that all medical and promotional activities comply with global guidelines and regulatory requirements

People Leadership

• Lead and develop one direct report , fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high‑performing environment

• Attract, mentor, and retain talent through servant leadership , coaching, and empowerment

• Support a culture where diverse voices are encouraged and valued

What We’re Looking For

Education & E

Abbott è un luogo in cui la scienza, lo scopo e le persone si uniscono — e dove prospettive diverse, leadership inclusiva, e la collaborazione sono essenziali per costruire migliori risultati per i pazienti. JOB DESCRIPTION:
Global Medical Director – Gastroenterology

Abbott | Established Pharmaceutical Division

About Abbott

At Abbott , we believe people live their fullest lives when they are healthy — physically, emotionally, and socially . As a global healthcare leader with more than 107,000 colleagues across 160+ countries , we develop life‑changing medicines and technologies that support health at every stage of life.

Within our Branded Generics business, we make trusted, high‑quality medicines accessible to more than 18 million people every day , particularly in fast‑growing regions such as LATAM, APAC, India, and Emerging Markets . Our diverse portfolio spans critical therapeutic areas including Women’s Health, Gastroenterology, Cardiometabolic, CNS & Pain, and Respiratory , addressing real and often unmet patient needs worldwide.

Abbott is a place where science, purpose, and people come together — and where diverse perspectives and inclusive leadership are essential to delivering better outcomes for patients globally.
Your Impact

As Global Medical Director – Gastroenterology , you will play a central role in shaping Abbott’s global medical strategy for the GI therapeutic area. Working closely with cross‑functional partners, you will help define short‑ and long‑term direction , ensuring medical decision‑making is scientifically robust, patient‑centered, and aligned with global and local needs.

You will be a core member of the Medical Affairs Leadership Team within the Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD), contributing your expertise and perspective to strategic decisions across Medical Affairs and Innovation & Development.

What You Will Do

Medical Strategy & Scientific Leadership

• Lead the global medical strategy and activities for the Gastroenterology therapeutic area and assigned products

• Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to translate scientific insight into meaningful medical and patient impact

• Identify unmet medical needs and mid‑ to long‑term opportunities for differentiation, innovation, and value creation

• Continuously evaluate products within scope, identifying portfolio gap‑filling opportunities , including in‑licensing considerations

• Develop therapeutic area medical plans , integrating research priorities, publication strategies, real‑world evidence, and study initiatives

• Prepare Target Product Profiles (TPPs) in partnership with cross‑functional teams

• Drive scientific excellence by reviewing medical literature and generating differentiated ideas (including digital) to strengthen disease management and patient care

Evidence Generation & Governance

• Lead and govern Global Medical Affairs research projects , including IIS, post‑marketing studies, observational and epidemiologic research, Phase IV and RWE studies

• Serve as a member of the Scientific Review Committee , jointly reviewing and approving clinical activities led by Clinical Development

• Ensure high‑quality medical content for digital initiatives aimed at both HCPs and patients

Collaboration, Safety & Compliance

• Build and maintain strong collaboration with regional and local Medical Directors , ensuring alignment between global strategy and local execution

• Establish and sustain trusted, ethical relationships with Key Opinion Leaders and scientific societies

• Act as a core member of the Product Safety Team , overseeing medical safety monitoring and contributing to PSURs, clinical overviews, and risk‑management plans

• As part of the Labeling Sub‑Team , provide medical input and scientific strategies for global and national label changes, including safety‑related updates

• Ensure that all medical and promotional activities comply with global guidelines and regulatory requirements

People Leadership

• Lead and develop a team of two direct reports , fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high‑performing environment

• Attract, mentor, and retain talent through servant leadership , coaching, and emp

Abbott Diabetes Care ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Diabetesmanagement und setzt sich dafür ein, Menschen mit Diabetes ein gesünderes und erfüllteres Leben zu ermöglichen. Durch kontinuierliche Innovation und ein konsequentes Qualitätsversprechen bietet Abbott hochmoderne Systeme zur Glukoseüberwachung an, darunter die renommierte Produktfamilie FreeStyle Libre™ . Diese Produkte liefern präzise und zuverlässige Glukosewerte und unterstützen Patient:innen sowie medizinisches Fachpersonal dabei, Diabetes besser zu steuern. Die Mission von Abbott ist es, die Diabetesversorgung durch wegweisende Technologien und nachhaltige Unterstützung kontinuierlich voranzubringen – für bestmögliche gesundheitliche Ergebnisse weltweit.

Der/die Medical Educator ist eine außendienstbasierte, an medizinische Fachpersonen (HCPs) gerichtete Position bei Abbott Diabetes Care in der Schweiz. • Erledigung interner medizinisch‑wissenschaftlicher Aufgaben (z. B. Freigaben, Fair‑Market‑Value‑Bewertungen, B2B‑CRM‑Tätigkeiten) sowie administrative Unterstützung

• Zusammenarbeit mit ADC Medical Affairs DACH, EMEAP sowie Global Medical Affairs

• Unterstützung bei der Auswahl und Umsetzung spezieller Elemente und Veranstaltungen der FreeStyle Academy™

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Abbott Diabetes Care è un leader globale nella gestione del diabete e si impegna a consentire alle persone con diabete di vivere più sano e più soddisfacente. Grazie alla continua innovazione e alla costante promessa di qualità, Abbott offre sistemi di monitoraggio del glucosio all'avanguardia, tra cui la rinomata famiglia di prodotti FreeStyle LibreTM. Questi prodotti forniscono livelli di glucosio precisi e affidabili e aiutano i pazienti: professionisti interni e medici a controllare meglio il diabete. La missione di Abbott è di avanzare continuamente la cura del diabete attraverso tecnologie innovative e supporto sostenibile – per i migliori risultati di salute possibili in tutto il mondo. L'Educatore Medico è una posizione basata sul servizio esterno per la cura di Abbott Diabetes in Svizzera, che è rivolta a medici professionisti (HCP). Il compito principale è quello di fornire competenze mediche-scientifiche in diabetici e di svolgere una formazione medica di alta qualità sulle tecnologie di monitoraggio del glucosio a base di sensori (FreeStyle LibreTM) in Svizzera. L'obiettivo centrale della posizione è quello di supportare i team di trattamento del diabete per realizzare il pieno beneficio dei sistemi CGM per i loro collettivi di pazienti. Inoltre, il ruolo include la comunicazione credibile di informazioni scientifiche e il dialogo professionale con i medici e le istituzioni sanitarie nell'area assegnata. La posizione richiede una stretta e coerente collaborazione con colleghi commerciali, pur mantenendo completa indipendenza medica e massima integrità scientifica. Compiti - Fornire competenze mediche-scientifiche in diabetici per supportare i prodotti FreeStyle LibreTM in Svizzera; Assistenza tecnica per i medici
descriptionByLocale.en:
Descrizione Abbott Diabetes Care is a global leader in diabetes management, committed to helping people with diabetes live healthier, more fulfilling lives. Through continuous innovation and a consistent commitment to quality, Abbott offers state-of-the-art glucose monitoring systems, including the renowned FreeStyle Libre™ family of products. These products provide accurate and reliable glucose values ​​and help patients and healthcare professionals better manage diabetes. Abbott's mission is to continually advance diabetes care through groundbreaking technologies and sustainable support for the best possible health outcomes worldwide. Job
• Profile The Medical Educator is a field-based position aimed at healthcare professionals (HCPs) at Abbott Diabetes Care in Switzerland. The main task is to provide medical-scientific expertise in the field of diabetology and to conduct high-quality medical training on sensor-based glucose monitoring technologies (FreeStyle Libre™) in Switzerland. The central goal of the position is to support diabetes treatment teams in realizing the full benefits of CGM systems for their patient populations. In addition, the role includes the credible communication of scientific information as well as professional dialogue with medical professionals and health facilities in the assigned area. The position requires close and compliant collaboration with commercial colleagues while maintaining complete medical independence and the highest level of scientific integrity. Tasks - Providing medical-scientific expertise in the field of diabetology to support FreeStyle Libre™ products in Switzerland; Cross-functional collaboration to develop, coordinate and implement strategies and programs at customer level in the respective area - Creation and implementation of scientific and medical presentations for medical professionals - individually or in groups, in person, online or recorded - Conducting field visits to HCPs and evidence-based exchange on relevant medical-scientific topics in the responsible area - Planning, coordinating and implementing internal training and continuing education programs for employees on medical-scientific topics - Completion of internal medical-scientific tasks (e.g. releases, fair market value assessments, B2B CRM activities) as well as administrative support - establishment and maintenance of a network of professional societies, opinion leaders (KOLs), doctors and other relevant specialist personnel in the area - collaboration with ADC Medical Affairs DACH, EMEAP and Global Medical Affairs organization medical-scientific programs for local congresses including the implementation of specialist lectures - Support in the selection and implementation of special elements and events of the FreeStyle Academy™
• Qualifications - Recognized medical professional (e.g. Diabetes consultant, nutritionist or doctor) with extensive clinical experience in the care and treatment of people with diabetes - Experience in the pharmaceutical or medical technology industry - Established network in the field of diabetology in Switzerland - Proven proactive, solution-oriented (“can-do”) way of working - Strong organizational and project management skills - High digital competence and technical understanding - Team-oriented working style combined with creativity and initiative - Ability to cross-functional collaboration and effective work in matrix organizations - Fluent knowledge of German, English and French (depending on the level).

jobs.title: Tender Specialist
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Shape the Future of Healthcare with Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader dedicated to helping people live their best lives at every stage. Our portfolio spans life-changing technologies in diagnostics, medical devices, nutrition, and branded generic medicines. With 114,000 colleagues serving patients in 160+ countries, we are committed to advancing health worldwide.
At Abbott, we believe diverse perspectives make better decisions—and ultimately lead to better healthcare outcomes.

About the Role

Are you passionate about improving patient access and making data-driven decisions that create real-world impact?

We are looking for a Tender Specialist to join Abbott’s Established Pharmaceutical Division (EPD). In this role, you will work closely with the Global Tender Management Head and cross-functional teams to strengthen our tender capabilities, enhance processes, and support markets in delivering winning strategies.
This position offers strong exposure to global markets, senior stakeholders, and strategic initiatives—while giving you the opportunity to grow your expertise and shape how Abbott brings medicines to patients.

What You’ll Do

Market & Customer Insights

• Support analysis of customer and market data to inform tender strategies

• Track market trends and pricing dynamics to identify opportunities and risks

Tender Strategy & Performance

• Partner with the Global Tender Management Head to support strategy execution

• Monitor KPIs and prepare insights for stakeholders

• Collaborate with markets on high-priority tenders to maximize success

Processes & Tools

• Help ensure consistent application of Abbott’s global tender process

• Support adoption and effective use of tender management systems

• Contribute to continuous improvements that enhance efficiency and outcomes

Planning & Coordination

• Help maintain visibility of upcoming tender opportunities (9–12 months ahead)

• Support preparation of cross-functional plans for key tenders

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with teams across finance, supply chain, pricing, marketing, and local markets

• Facilitate communication across regions and functions

• Support and coordinate Tender Review Panels when needed

Capability Building

• Support development of tools, training materials, and best practices

• Help strengthen capabilities across local teams

Customer Value

• Contribute to the development of compelling value propositions tailored to customer needs

Ethics & Compliance

• Ensure adherence to Abbott policies, industry regulations, and ethical standards

What You Bring

We recognize that great candidates don’t always check every box. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if your experience doesn’t perfectly match every requirement.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree (advanced degree or MBA is a plus, not a requirement)

Experience

• Experience in project management, commercial roles, or healthcare/pharma environments

• Exposure to tender processes or pricing strategies is an advantage

• Experience working across teams or regions is beneficial

Skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to turn data into insights and actionable recommendations

• Collaborative mindset with the ability to influence across teams

• Clear communication and stakeholder management skills

• Interest in learning and developing in a global environment

Why Join Abbott?

• Meaningful impact : Contribute to improving access to treatments worldwide

• Growth & development : Mentoring, training, and career progression opportunities

• Inclusive culture : We value different perspectives and promote an environment where everyone can thrive

• Global exposure : Work with teams across regions and functions

Interested?

If this role sounds like a fit for you—or even if you’re not sure but are curious—we’d love to hear from you.
Send us your CV (PDF).

The base pay for this position is
N/A In sp

jobs.title: Senior Mechatronics Engineer
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Thoratec Switzerland GmbH is part of the medical device division of Abbott Laboratories , a fortune 500 company with over 115’000 employees worldwide. We are the global market leader for implantable and extracorporeal blood pumps based on magnetic levitation technology. Our life-saving systems, which we develop and manufacture in Zurich, are used for advanced heart failure patients needing short- or long-term circulatory support.

Our location in the heart of the city of Zurich has around 130 employees in the areas of development, quality and production of the CentriMag System and the HeartMate 3. We are looking for a motivated and talented

Sr. Mechatronics Engineer

Join our team in Zurich. Become part of a young and aspiring team which is responsible for design updates and maintenance of mechatronic devices and consumables for our implantable and extracorporeal blood pump systems. With your work, you’ll ensure our products stay at the forefront of innovation and meet the highest standards of our industry. In your role you will be interfacing and collaborating with cross-functional teams in Switzerland and the US.

Main Responsibilities

JOB DESCRIPTION:
(Senior) Financial Analyst – Drive Impact in Life-Saving Innovation

Location: Zurich, Switzerland

At Abbott’s Thoratec Switzerland GmbH , we develop technology that saves lives. As part of Abbott’s global medical device division (115,000+ employees worldwide), we are leaders in implantable and extracorporeal blood pump systems using advanced magnetic levitation technology.

From our Zurich site, a diverse team of ~130 colleagues collaborates across development, quality, and production to deliver the CentriMag System and HeartMate 3—supporting patients with advanced heart failure around the world.

Why this role matters

As a (Senior) Financial Analyst , you will play a key role in shaping financial insights that directly support innovation and patient impact. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams and leadership to help drive operational excellence, transparency, and smart decision-making.
This is an opportunity to combine analytical expertise with meaningful purpose , while growing into a strategic finance partner within a collaborative and supportive environment.

What you’ll do

• Act as a trusted finance partner for cost centers, capital investments, projects, inventory and windchill change orders

• Lead and support annual budgeting process and periodic forecasting process across assigned areas

• Partner with the business to monitor performance, identify opportunities, and support improvement initiatives

• Support full cycle of capital (planning, tracking, and post-investment)

• Monitor inventory and communicate financial implications and opportunities by partnering with local supply chain

• Contribute to continuous improvement in financial processes, tools, reporting and data accuracy

• Ensure compliance with financial controls, policies, and reporting requirements

• Execute deliverables in a consistent, timely, and accurate manner

• Play a key role in month-end activities by executing journal entries, performing variance analysis, and preparing reports

What you bring

We know great candidates don’t always meet every requirement. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply.

• Degree in Finance (or similar), with approximately 5+ years of experience, with at least 3 years in FP&A

• Experience in manufacturing or operations finance is a plus, but not essential

• Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail

• Ability to translate financial data into clear insights for different audiences

• Confidence working with systems and data (e.g., SAP, Dodeca/ Essbase, Excel and Power BI)

• Strong collaboration and communication skills

• Ability to manage priorities and navigate a dynamic environment and high-pressure situations

• Fluent English

What we offer

• A purpose-driven role contributing to life-saving technologies

• A collaborative and inclusive culture where different perspectives are valued

• Opportunities for growth and specialization (including becoming a costing SME)

• Flexibility and autonomy in how you manage your work

• A modern workplace in the heart of Zurich

Join us

We are looking for curious, motivated individuals who enjoy solving problems, working together, and making an impact.
If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

Apply via our career site: Abbott Laboratories Careers

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Thoratec Switzerland GmbH , part of Abbott Laboratories, is a global leader in life-saving medical technologies. Our innovative systems, developed and manufactured in Zurich, support patients with advanced heart failure. With around 130 colleagues in development, quality, and production, we work together to make a real difference in people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

Process Validations and Equipment Qualification:

• Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to validate processes and qualify equipment.

• Evaluate, review, and approve validation and qualification plans, reports, and risk files.

Non-Conforming Material (NCMR) Handling:

• Manage the complete handling of non-conforming materials (NCMR).

• Develop and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) based on NCMR findings.

• Document, track, and trend NCMRs, ensuring timely and effective corrections.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve non-conformance issues and prevent recurrence.

Root Cause Analysis:

• Lead root cause analysis and problem-solving activities for quality issues.

• Investigate and resolve non-conformances.

• Drive the CAPA process to identify root causes of quality issues, implement corrective actions, and verify their effectiveness.

• Develop preventive measures to avoid recurrence.

Data Analysis and Reporting:

• Analyze and report trends and statistical data from investigations in collaboration with Manufacturing Engineering and company management.

Audit Participation:

• Participate in internal and external audits, providing necessary documentation and support.

• Act as an NCMR Subject Matter Expert (SME) during audits.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

• Work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, procurement, and manufacturing, to address quality-related issues.

Continuous Improvement:

• Champion continuous improvement initiatives within the quality department.

• Implement best practices and innovative solutions to enhance product quality and process efficiency.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, quality management, or a related field.

• Experience in medical devices or a similar industry.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in quality engineering, with a focus on NCMR, validations, and CAPA.

• Strong knowledge of quality management systems and regulatory requirements.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and experience with root cause analysis methodologies.

• Proficient in using quality tools and software.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

• In-depth experience in process and test method validation (TMV, IMV, IQ/OQ/PQ) and the application of statistical methods.

• Experience with CAPA processes.

• Proficiency in both written and spoken German and English.

Reporting/Supervisory Structure:

• Reporting line according to the Organizational Chart.

• Demonstrates ability as an individual contributor.

• Works under management direction.

• Fulfills tasks based on delegated competencies given from management.

Working at Abbott
At Abbott, you can do work that matters and help people to live a healthier and fuller life, grow your career, and learn, be your true self. You will have access to:

• Career development with an international company where you can grow

• A workplace in a fortune 500 company and the world’s leading manufacturer of medical devices

• A challenging position in a crisis independent industry

• To become part of a dynamic, highly educated, highly skilled, and motivated team

• Multi-national environment, where we foster the development of our talents within the enterprise

• Competitive compensations and benefits

• A workplace in the heart of Zurich

I nostri sistemi innovativi, sviluppati e prodotti a Zurigo, supportano i pazienti con insufficienza cardiaca avanzata. Con circa 130 colleghi addetti allo sviluppo, alla qualità e alla produzione, lavoriamo insieme per fare davvero la differenza nella vita delle persone. Responsabilità principali: Convalide dei processi e qualificazione delle apparecchiature:
• Collaborare con l'ingegneria di produzione per convalidare i processi e qualificare le apparecchiature.
• Valutare, rivedere e approvare piani, report e file di rischio di convalida e qualificazione. Movimentazione dei materiali non conformi (NCMR):
• Gestire la movimentazione completa dei materiali non conformi (NCMR).
• Sviluppare e implementare azioni correttive e preventive (CAPA) sulla base dei risultati dell'NCMR.
• Documentare, tenere traccia e definire l'andamento degli NCMR, garantendo correzioni tempestive ed efficaci.
• Collaborare con team interfunzionali per risolvere problemi di non conformità e prevenirne il ripetersi. Analisi delle cause profonde:
• Condurre l'analisi delle cause profonde e le attività di risoluzione dei problemi relativi alla qualità.
• Investigare e risolvere le non conformità.
• Guidare il processo CAPA per identificare le cause profonde dei problemi di qualità, implementare azioni correttive e verificarne l'efficacia.
• Sviluppare misure preventive per evitare il ripetersi. Analisi e reporting dei dati:
• Analizzare e riportare tendenze e dati statistici provenienti da indagini in collaborazione con l'ingegneria di produzione e il management aziendale. Partecipazione agli audit:
• Partecipare agli audit interni ed esterni, fornendo la documentazione e il supporto necessari.
• Agire come esperto in materia NCMR (PMI) durante gli audit. Collaborazione interfunzionale:
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con team interfunzionali, tra cui ingegneria, approvvigionamento e produzione, per affrontare le questioni relative alla qualità. Miglioramento continuo:
• Promuovere iniziative di miglioramento continuo all'interno del reparto qualità.
• Implementare le migliori pratiche e soluzioni innovative per migliorare la qualità dei prodotti e l'efficienza dei processi. Qualifiche:
• Laurea in ingegneria, gestione della qualità o in un campo correlato.
• Esperienza in dispositivi medici o in un settore simile.
• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria della qualità, con particolare attenzione a NCMR, convalide e CAPA.
• Conoscenza approfondita dei sistemi di gestione della qualità e dei requisiti normativi.
• Eccellenti capacità di problem solving ed esperienza con le metodologie di analisi delle cause profonde.
• Competente nell'uso di strumenti e software di qualità.
• Forti capacità comunicative e interpersonali, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente di squadra.
• Esperienza approfondita nella validazione di processi e metodi di prova (TMV, IMV, IQ/OQ/PQ) e nell'applicazione di metodi statistici.
• Esperienza con i processi CAPA.
• Conoscenza della lingua tedesca e inglese sia scritta che parlata. Struttura di reporting/vigilanza:
• Linea di riporto secondo l'Organigramma.
• Dimostra abilità come collaboratore individuale.
• Lavora sotto la direzione della direzione.
• Svolge compiti basati sulle competenze delegate fornite dalla direzione. Lavorare in Abbott In Abbott puoi svolgere il lavoro che conta e aiutare le persone a vivere una vita più sana e piena, far crescere la tua carriera e imparare, essere te stesso. Avrai accesso a:
• Sviluppo di carriera con un'azienda internazionale dove puoi crescere
• Un posto di lavoro in un'azienda Fortune 500 e il principale produttore mondiale di dispositivi medici
• Una posizione stimolante in un settore indipendente dalla crisi
• Entrare a far parte di un team dinamico, altamente istruito, altamente qualificato e motivato
• Ambiente multinazionale, dove promuoviamo lo sviluppo dei nostri talenti all'interno dell'azienda
• Compensi e benefit competitivi

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Thoratec Switzerland GmbH , part of Abbott Laboratories, is a global leader in life-saving medical technologies. Our innovative systems, developed and manufactured in Zurich, support patients with advanced heart failure. With around 130 colleagues in development, quality, and production, we work together to make a real difference in people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

Process Validations and Equipment Qualification:

• Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to validate processes and qualify equipment.

• Evaluate, review, and approve validation and qualification plans, reports, and risk files.

Non-Conforming Material (NCMR) Handling:

• Manage the complete handling of non-conforming materials (NCMR).

• Develop and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) based on NCMR findings.

• Document, track, and trend NCMRs, ensuring timely and effective corrections.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve non-conformance issues and prevent recurrence.

Root Cause Analysis:

• Lead root cause analysis and problem-solving activities for quality issues.

• Investigate and resolve non-conformances.

• Drive the CAPA process to identify root causes of quality issues, implement corrective actions, and verify their effectiveness.

• Develop preventive measures to avoid recurrence.

Data Analysis and Reporting:

• Analyze and report trends and statistical data from investigations in collaboration with Manufacturing Engineering and company management.

Audit Participation:

• Participate in internal and external audits, providing necessary documentation and support.

• Act as an NCMR Subject Matter Expert (SME) during audits.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

• Work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, procurement, and manufacturing, to address quality-related issues.

Continuous Improvement:

• Champion continuous improvement initiatives within the quality department.

• Implement best practices and innovative solutions to enhance product quality and process efficiency.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, quality management, or a related field.

• Experience in medical devices or a similar industry.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in quality engineering, with a focus on NCMR, validations, and CAPA.

• Strong knowledge of quality management systems and regulatory requirements.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and experience with root cause analysis methodologies.

• Proficient in using quality tools and software.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

• In-depth experience in process and test method validation (TMV, IMV, IQ/OQ/PQ) and the application of statistical methods.

• Experience with CAPA processes.

• Proficiency in both written and spoken German and English.

Reporting/Supervisory Structure:

• Reporting line according to the Organizational Chart.

• Demonstrates ability as an individual contributor.

• Works under management direction.

• Fulfills tasks based on delegated competencies given from management.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters and help people to live a healthier and fuller life, grow your career, and learn, be your true self. You will have access to:

• Career development with an international company where you can grow

• A workplace in a fortune 500 company and the world’s leading manufacturer of medical devices

• A challenging position in a crisis independent industry

• To become part of a dynamic, highly educated, highly skilled, and motivated team

• Multi-national environment, where we foster the development of our talents within the enterprise

• Competitive compensations and benefits

• A workplace in the heart of Zurich

• Esperienza in dispositivi medici o in un settore simile.

• Eccellenti capacità di problem solving ed esperienza con le metodologie di analisi delle cause profonde.
• Competente nell'uso di strumenti e software di qualità.
• Forti capacità comunicative e interpersonali, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente di squadra.

• Esperienza con i processi CAPA.

• Fördern Sie Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung innerhalb der Qualitätsabteilung.
• Best Practices und innovative Lösungen implementieren, um Produktqualität und Prozesseffizienz zu verbessern. Qualifikationen:
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Qualitätsmanagement oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• Erfahrung in der Medizintechnik oder einer ähnlichen Branche.
• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Qualitätstechnik mit Schwerpunkt auf NCMR, Validierungen und CAPA.
• Umfangreiche Kenntnisse über Qualitätsmanagementsysteme und behördliche Anforderungen.
• Hervorragende Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung und Erfahrung mit Methoden zur Ursachenanalyse.

• Erfahrung mit CAPA-Prozessen.
• Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Berichts-/Aufsichtsstruktur:

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader committed to helping people live their fullest lives at every stage. With a broad portfolio spanning diagnostics, medical devices, nutrition, and branded generic medicines, our 114,000 colleagues serve patients in over 160 countries, driving innovation that advances health worldwide.

Within Abbott’s Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD), we are expanding our Women’s Health team and are seeking an experienced Global Medical Manager – Women’s Health to support our continued growth.

In this global role, you will partner closely with regional and affiliate Medical teams, Innovation & Development, and Global Marketing, reporting directly to the Global Medical Director of Women’s Health.

Main Responsibilities

• Responsible for specific activities and strategic projects within Medical Affairs for the Women`s Health Portfolio

• Support the Global Medical Director in reviewing, approving and overviewing global and regional medical / clinical studies and publications relevant to the therapeutic area

• In close collaboration with the Global and Regional Marketing Teams, plan and execute prelaunch activities of cross-regional products/brands

• With collaboration of regional medical teams run Key Opinion Leader assessment and identification projects, organize Key Opinion Leaders database, ensure regular updates, identify potential global Key Opinion Leaders, and inform internal stakeholder on potential global Key Opinion Leader candidates

• Work on medical maintenance of global brands by participating in product safety team meetings, Labeling team meetings, writing and/or reviewing scientific documents, updating product scientific library, etc.

• Collaborating with marketing team on developing promotional materials, including sales aids, web pages, digital platforms, etc. and ensuring scientific validity of the contents

• For geo-expansion of local products, update/upgrade scientific part of registration dossiers in order to get them into approvable standards in other countries.

• Conduct medical assessments on new Licensing & Acquisition opportunities for portfolio expansion

The profile

• Medical Doctor degree and/or PhD in related life sciences with relevant pharmaceutical industry experience in regional or global roles

• At least 5 years of regional or global responsibility for comparable products

• Clinical research experience is an additional merit

• Operating within and cross-functional international /global geographic area

• Strong project management skills across several functional areas

• First international experience, especially in emerging markets is a plus

• Willing to work hands on and be able to think strategically at the same time

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Medical Educator - Romandie

Abbott Diabetes Care est un leader mondial dans le domaine de la gestion du diabète et s’engage à permettre aux personnes atteintes de diabète de mener une vie plus saine et plus épanouie. Grâce à une innovation continue et à un engagement constant envers la qualité, Abbott propose des systèmes de surveillance du glucose de pointe, notamment la célèbre gamme de produits FreeStyle Libre™ . Ces produits fournissent des valeurs de glucose précises et fiables et aident les patients ainsi que les professionnels de santé à mieux gérer le diabète.
La mission d’Abbott est de faire progresser en permanence la prise en charge du diabète grâce à des technologies innovantes et à un accompagnement durable, pour obtenir les meilleurs résultats de santé possibles à l’échelle mondiale.

Le/la Medical Educator est un poste terrain, orienté vers les professionnels de santé (HCPs), au sein d’Abbott Diabetes Care en Suisse. Sa mission principale consiste à fournir une expertise médico-scientifique en diabétologie et à assurer des formations médicales de haute qualité sur les technologies de surveillance du glucose par capteur (FreeStyle Libre™) en Suisse.
L’objectif central du poste est de soutenir les équipes de traitement du diabète afin qu’elles puissent tirer pleinement parti des systèmes CGM pour leurs populations de patients. Le rôle inclut également la transmission crédible d’informations scientifiques ainsi que le dialogue professionnel avec les acteurs de santé dans la zone géographique attribuée.
Le poste requiert une collaboration étroite et conforme avec les équipes commerciales, tout en garantissant une indépendance médicale totale et une intégrité scientifique maximale.

Vos responsabilités

• Fournir une expertise médico-scientifique en diabétologie pour soutenir les produits FreeStyle Libre™ en Suisse ; collaborer de manière transversale pour développer, aligner et mettre en œuvre des stratégies et programmes au niveau des clients dans votre secteur

• Créer et présenter des exposés scientifiques et médicaux destinés aux professionnel·le·s de santé , individuellement ou en groupe, en présentiel, en ligne ou sous forme enregistrée

• Effectuer des visites terrain auprès des HCPs et échanger sur des sujets médico-scientifiques pertinents sur la base des données scientifiques disponibles

• Planifier, coordonner et animer des programmes internes de formation et de perfectionnement sur des sujets médico-scientifiques

• Réaliser des tâches médico-scientifiques internes (par ex. validations, évaluations de Fair Market Value, activités CRM B2B) ainsi qu’un support administratif

• Développer et entretenir un réseau comprenant sociétés savantes, leaders d’opinion (KOLs), médecins et autres professionnel·le·s de santé pertinents

• Collaborer avec les équipes Medical Affairs d’ADC en DACH, EMEAP et au niveau global

• Organiser des programmes médico-scientifiques pour des congrès locaux, y compris la réalisation de présentations spécialisées

• Soutenir la sélection et la mise en œuvre d’éléments et d’événements spécifiques de la FreeStyle Academy™

Vos qualifications

• Professionnel de santé reconnu (par ex. éducateur en diabète, diététicien ou médecin) avec une solide expérience clinique dans la prise en charge des personnes atteintes de diabète

• Expérience dans l’industrie pharmaceutique ou des dispositifs médicaux

• Réseau établi dans le domaine de la diabétologie en Suisse

• Capacité démontrée à travailler de manière proactive et orientée solutions

• Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et en gestion de projet

• Forte aisance digitale et compréhension technique

• Esprit d’équipe associé à créativité et autonomie

• Capacité à collaborer de manière transversale et à évoluer efficacement dans une organisation matricielle

• Maîtrise du français, de l’allemand et de l’anglais (selon la région), l’italien étant un atout

• Forte mobilité (environ 80 %, poste terrain)

jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Senior Quality Engineer

Zurich, Switzerland | Thoratec Switzerland GmbH (Abbott)
Build life‑saving technology — in a team where your growth matters.

At Thoratec Switzerland GmbH , part of Abbott’s Medical Devices division , we develop and manufacture advanced heart pump systems that support patients with severe heart failure around the world. Our technologies — including CentriMag and HeartMate 3 — are designed and produced in Zurich and play a vital role in saving and improving lives every day.

Our local team of around 140 colleagues across Development, Quality, and Production combines deep expertise with a collaborative, respectful culture. We believe that the best innovations happen when diverse perspectives come together — and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive and grow.

As we continue to expand, we are looking for a Senior Quality Engineer to join our team and help ensure the highest standards of quality, safety, and performance for our products.

About the Role

In this role, you will contribute to the quality and compliance of life‑saving medical devices while working closely with cross-functional teams. You will play an important part in strengthening quality systems, driving improvements, and supporting both internal and external stakeholders.
This is a role for someone who enjoys collaboration, problem-solving, and continuous learning — and who wants to make a meaningful impact through their work.

What You’ll Do

• Implement aspects of production quality assurance and document control activities to ensure compliance with internal procedures and international regulations.

• Execute quality organization activities ensuring product quality, performance, and safety.

• Support communication with Operations and external suppliers to resolve quality issues.

• Drive Quality Systems goals and objectives at site level.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Compliance:

• Ensure facility-wide compliance with quality systems and regulatory requirements.

Quality Analysis and Reporting:

• Analyze and report quality metrics and trends.

• Develop, maintain, and present dashboards for quality data reporting and decision-making.

Non-conforming Product:

• Resolve or escalate issues and coordinate corrective actions with suppliers.

• Take ownership of supplier non-conformances and manage them throughout all the remediation process

Supplier Quality:

• Perform audits at supplier sites to ensure compliance with quality and regulatory requirements.
Manage supplier qualification documentation, ensuring completeness and compliance.

• Coordinate and oversee validations conducted at supplier locations.

• Manages internal and external reporting, reports, and dashboards related to supplier-related KPIs

Change Management:

• Manage and support change control processes, including assessment, approval, implementation, and effectiveness checks of changes.

Quality System Procedures:

• Support the administration and improvement of quality assurance procedures.

Supplier Change Notifications:

• Reviews and manages supplier change notifications, ensuring timely risk assessment, cross-functional alignment, and proper approval and implementation in compliance with internal procedures and regulatory requirements.

Audit

• Actively support the certified bodies and authorities, as well as the internal audits received by the site.

Corrective and Preventive Actions:

• Analyze trends and determine root causes.

• Implement CAPA actions.

General:

• Travel as required (20% aprox.)

• Perform additional tasks assigned by QA management.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor or Master degree in Science, Engineering, or other technical field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a medical-device manufacturing or other regulated industry in a quality-related role.

• Experience conducting and / or reviewing validations.

• Supplier Audit experience preferred.

• Certified body audit and Inspection experience

DESCRIZIONE: Ingegnere di qualità senior Zurigo, Svizzera | Thoratec Switzerland GmbH (Abbott) Costruire la tecnologia salvavita — in un team in cui la vostra crescita conta. A Thoratec Switzerland GmbH, parte della divisione Dispositivi Medici di Abbott, sviluppiamo e produciamo sistemi di pompa cardiaca avanzati che supportano i pazienti con grave insufficienza cardiaca in tutto il mondo. Le nostre tecnologie, tra cui CentriMag e HeartMate 3, sono progettate e prodotte a Zurigo e svolgono un ruolo vitale nel salvare e migliorare la vita ogni giorno. Il nostro team locale di circa 140 colleghi di Sviluppo, Qualità e Produzione combina una profonda esperienza con una cultura collaborativa e rispettosa. Crediamo che le migliori innovazioni avvengano quando si riuniscono prospettive diverse — e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente in cui tutti possano prosperare e crescere. Mentre continuiamo ad espanderci, stiamo cercando un Senior Quality Engineer per unirsi al nostro team e contribuire a garantire i più elevati standard di qualità, sicurezza e prestazioni per i nostri prodotti. Informazioni sul ruolo In questo ruolo, contribuirai alla qualità e alla conformità dei dispositivi medicali salvavita, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team interfunzionali. Si svolgerà un ruolo importante nel rafforzare i sistemi di qualità, migliorare la guida e sostenere sia gli stakeholder interni che esterni. Questo è un ruolo per qualcuno che gode di collaborazione, problem solving e apprendimento continuo — e che vuole fare un impatto significativo attraverso il loro lavoro. Cosa farai
• Aspetti di attuazione delle attività di garanzia della qualità della produzione e di controllo dei documenti per garantire il rispetto delle procedure interne e delle normative internazionali.
• Eseguire attività di organizzazione di qualità che garantiscono la qualità del prodotto, le prestazioni e la sicurezza.
• Supporta la comunicazione con Operazioni e fornitori esterni per risolvere problemi di qualità.
• Guida obiettivi e obiettivi dei sistemi di qualità a livello del sito. Doveri e responsabilità: Compliance:
• Assicurare la conformità a livello degli impianti ai sistemi di qualità e ai requisiti normativi. Analisi della Qualità e Reporting:
• Analizzare e segnalare metriche di qualità e tendenze.
• Sviluppare, mantenere e presentare dashboard per la segnalazione dei dati di qualità e il processo decisionale. Prodotto non conforme:
• Risolvere o escalare i problemi e coordinare le azioni correttive con i fornitori.
• Assumere la proprietà dei fornitori non conformi e gestirli durante tutto il processo di bonifica Qualità del fornitore:
• Eseguire controlli presso i siti dei fornitori per garantire il rispetto dei requisiti di qualità e normazione. Gestisci la documentazione di qualificazione del fornitore, garantendo la completezza e la conformità.
• Coordinare e supervisionare le validazioni condotte nelle sedi dei fornitori.
• Gestisce report, report e dashboard interni ed esterni relativi ai KPI correlati ai fornitori Gestione dei cambiamenti:
• Gestione e supporto dei processi di controllo dei cambiamenti, inclusi i controlli di valutazione, approvazione, implementazione e efficacia delle modifiche. Procedure di Sistema di Qualità:
• Sostenere l'amministrazione e il miglioramento delle procedure di garanzia della qualità. Notifiche di cambiamento del fornitore:
• Recensioni e gestisce le notifiche di cambiamento dei fornitori, assicurando una valutazione tempestiva dei rischi, un allineamento interfunzionale e una corretta approvazione e implementazione nel rispetto delle procedure interne e dei requisiti normativi. Audit
• Supporta attivamente gli enti e le autorità certificati, nonché i controlli interni ricevuti dal sito. Azioni correttive e preventive:
• Analizzare le tendenze e determinare le cause della radice.
• Attuazione delle azioni della PACA. Generale:
• Viaggiare come richiesto (20% grembiule.)
• Eseguire ulteriori compiti assegnati dalla gestione QA. Qualifiche:
• Laurea o Master in Scienze, Ingegneria o altro campo tecnico.
• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza in una produzione di dispositivi medici o in un altro settore regolamentato in un ruolo legato alla qualità.
• Esperienza di conduzione e / o revisione delle validazioni.
• Fornitore Audit esperienza preferita.
• Prova certificata del corpo e esperienza di ispezione

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Abbott ist ein global tätiges Unternehmen im Gesundheitswesen, das sich mit der Erforschung, Entwicklung und Herstellung von Produkten in den Bereichen Medizintechnik, Pharmazeutik, Diagnostik und medizinischer Ernährung befasst. Das Unternehmen vermarktet seine Produkte weltweit und beschäftigt ungefähr 99‘000 Mitarbeitende in 150 Ländern. In der Schweiz beschäftigt Abbott rund 470 Mitarbeitende.

Abbott bietet Ihnen die Chance, die Welt nachhaltig zu verändern. Als Mitarbeiter eines erfolgreichen und renommierten Unternehmens meistern Sie schwierige und zugleich lohnenswerte Herausforderungen und prägen die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung.

Für unser Abbott Diabetes Care Team in Baar , Schweiz suchen wir per sofort eine selbständige, teamorientierte und aufgestellte Persönlichkeit als

Brand Manager (m/w/d) 100%. Die Anstellung ist zunächst für 1 Jahr befristet und erfolgt über eine Payrollagentur.

Als Mitarbeiter/in in unserem Marketing Team arbeiten Sie am Puls unserer Division. Mit Ihrer strukturierten und vernetzt denkenden Art leisten Sie einen wichtigen Beitrag, die globale Strategie in lokale Massnahmen umzusetzen für unsere FreeStyle Libre Anwender/innen. Dies schaffen Sie dank Ihrer Erfahrung in der Pharma- oder Medizintechnikbranche spielend in 3 unserer Landessprachen (Deutsch, Französisch, Italienisch).

Ihr Aufgabenbereich umfasst folgende Bereiche:

• Lokale Umsetzung der globalen Strategie im Bereich Consumer Marketing

• Planen und implementieren von Massnahmen (digital und Print) inkl. Budgetplanung und -kontrolle im Opti-Channel-Marketing

• Festlegen und analysieren von relevanten KPI’s sowie laufende Optimierung der Aktivitäten auf Basis dieser Resultate (ROI)

• Ansprechperson für unsere internen und externen Partner

• Interne Schnittstelle zu anderen Abteilungen (lokal, europäisch und global) und dem Aussendienst

Sie verfügen über eine zuverlässige, selbständige und zielorientierte Hands-On-Arbeitsweise und bringen folgende Voraussetzungen mit:

• Hochschulabschluss in Marketing oder Betriebswirtschaft oder fundierte, relevante Berufserfahrung in einem vergleichbaren Bereich

• Mehrjährige Marketingerfahrung in der Schweizer Pharma- oder Medizintechnikbranche mit Fokus auf digitalem Marketing

• Sprachkenntnisse: Verhandlungssicher in Wort und Schrift in Deutsch, Französisch und Englisch sowie fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Italienisch

• Fähigkeit, sich in unsere Kund:innen hineinzuversetzen und entsprechende Massnahmen zu planen

• Stärke in der Umsetzung von Massnahmen in 3 Sprachen (Deutsch, Französisch, Italienisch)

• Affinität für digitale Gesundheitstools

• Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Agenturen und Organisation von lokalen Kongressen

• Sicheres Auftreten im Umgang mit internen und externen Stakeholdern

• Verständnis für interne Prozesse und deren Einhaltung

• Ausgeprägte Team- und Kundenorientierung in internationalem Umfeld

• Situationsangepasste Flexibiltiät für erfolgreiches Priorisieren und eigener Anspruch an qualitativ hochstehende Umsetzung in einer agilen Umgebung

• Reisebereitschaft bis zu 20%

Wenn Sie eine flexible, aufgeschlossene und engagierte Persönlichkeit sind, bietet Ihnen Abbott nicht nur eine abwechslungsreiche und anspruchsvolle Aufgabe sondern auch eine angenehme und offene Arbeitsatmosphäre in einem spannenden, internationalen Umfeld.

N/A In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

L'azienda commercializza i suoi prodotti in tutto il mondo e impiega circa 99.000 persone in 150 paesi. Abbott impiega circa 470 persone in Svizzera. Abbott ti offre l'opportunità di cambiare il mondo in modo sostenibile. Come dipendente di una società di successo e rinomata, si padroneggiano sfide difficili e allo stesso tempo vale la pena e modellano il futuro della salute. Per il nostro Abbott Diabetes Care Team di Baar, in Svizzera stiamo cercando una personalità indipendente, orientata al team e consolidata come Brand Manager (m/f/d) 100% È inizialmente una distribuzione per un anno, con l'occupazione che viene effettuata tramite un partner esterno payrolling. Come dipendente del nostro team di marketing, lavori sul polso della nostra divisione. Con il vostro modo di pensare strutturato e in rete, contribuite in modo importante all'attuazione della strategia globale nelle misure locali per i nostri utenti FreeStyle Libre. Grazie alla vostra esperienza nel settore farmaceutico o medicale, potete farlo in 3 lingue nazionali (tedesco, francese, italiano). Le sue responsabilità includono i seguenti settori:
• implementazione locale della strategia globale nel settore del marketing dei consumatori
• Programmazione e attuazione di misure (digitali e stampa) incl. Pianificazione e controllo del bilancio nel marketing opti-channel
• Determinazione e analisi dei KPI rilevanti e ottimizzazione continua delle attività basate su questi risultati (ROI)
• Persona di contatto per i nostri partner interni ed esterni
• Interfaccia interna ad altri dipartimenti (locali, europei e globali) e servizio sul campo Hai uno stile di lavoro pratico, affidabile, indipendente e orientato all'obiettivo e hai i seguenti prerequisiti:
• Laurea in marketing o amministrazione aziendale o suono, esperienza professionale rilevante in un settore comparabile
• Diversi anni di esperienza di marketing nel settore farmaceutico o medicale svizzero con un focus sul marketing digitale
• Capacità linguistiche:
• Capacità di mettersi nei nostri clienti: all'interno e pianificare le misure appropriate
• Forza nell'attuazione delle misure in 3 lingue (tedesco, francese, italiano)
• Affinità per gli strumenti di salute digitale
• Esperienza nel lavoro con le agenzie e organizzazione di congressi locali
• Approccio sicuro agli stakeholder interni ed esterni
• Comprensione dei processi interni e della loro conformità
• Forte e orientamento al cliente in un ambiente internazionale Se sei una personalità flessibile, aperta e impegnata, Abbott ti offre non solo un compito vario e impegnativo, ma anche un ambiente di lavoro piacevole e aperto in un ambiente emozionante e internazionale.
