JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott is a global healthcare company engaged in the research, development and manufacture of products in the fields of medical technology, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics and medical nutrition. The company markets its products worldwide and employs approximately 99,000 people in 150 countries. Abbott employs around 470 people in Switzerland. Abbott offers you the opportunity to change the world sustainably. As an employee of a successful and renowned company, you master difficult and at the same time worthwhile challenges and shape the future of healthcare. For our Abbott Diabetes Care Team in Baar, Switzerland we are looking for an independent, team-oriented and established personality as a Brand Manager (m/f/d) 100% It is initially a deployment for one year, with the employment being carried out via an external payrolling partner. As an employee in our marketing team, you work on the pulse of our division. With your structured and networked way of thinking, you make an important contribution to implementing the global strategy into local measures for our FreeStyle Libre users. Thanks to your experience in the pharmaceutical or medical technology industry, you can do this in 3 of our national languages (German, French, Italian). Her responsibilities include the following areas:
• Local implementation of the global strategy in the area of consumer marketing
• Planning and implementing measures (digital and print) incl. Budget planning and control in opti-channel marketing
• Determining and analyzing relevant KPIs as well as ongoing optimization of activities based on these results (ROI)
• Contact person for our internal and external partners
• Internal interface to other departments (local, European and global) and the field service You have a reliable, independent and goal-oriented hands-on working style and have the following prerequisites:
• University degree in marketing or business administration or sound, relevant professional experience in a comparable area
• Several years of marketing experience in the Swiss pharmaceutical or medical technology industry with a focus on digital marketing
• Language skills: Confident in words and writing in German, French and English as well as advanced knowledge in Italian
• Ability to put oneself in our customers: inside and plan appropriate measures
• Strength in the implementation of measures in 3 languages (German, French, Italian)
• Affinity for digital health tools
• Experience in working with agencies and organising local congresses
• Secure approach to internal and external stakeholders
• Understanding internal processes and their compliance
• Strong team and customer orientation in an international environment
• Situation-adapted flexibility for successful prioritisation and your own demand for high-quality implementation in an agile environment
• Willingness to travel up to 20% If you are a flexible, open-minded and committed personality, Abbott offers you not only a varied and challenging task but also a pleasant and open working atmosphere in an exciting, international environment. The base pay for this position is N/A In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted. jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Thoratec Switzerland GmbH is a part of Abbott Laboratories, one of the world's leading manufacturers of medical devices. We are the global market leader for implantable and extracorporeal blood pumps based on magnetic levitation technology. Our life-saving systems, which we develop and manufacture in Zurich, are used for acute and long-term therapy in patients with severe heart disease.

Our location in the city of Zurich has around 150 employees in the areas of development and production of the Centri MagTM system and the HeartMate 3TM motor.

As we grow our current Team, we are looking for a passionate, open minded and down to earth person to join our Team.

Manufacturing Engineer – Line Support

Manufacturing Engineering is responsible for production support and optimization. As a Line Support Engineer , you serve as the primary point of contact for resolving production issues, driving rapid problem-solving, investigating deviations and maintaining smooth, compliant operations in close collaboration with cross-functional teams. You are committed to ensuring uninterrupted manufacturing operations and enabling the production team to maintain output safely, efficiently, and in compliance with quality requirements.

You will:

• Provide first level support for the manufacturing floor in cases of technical problems, ensuring production can continue with minimal disruption

• Investigate and evaluate production deviations (Event Descriptions), determine material disposition in collaboration with Quality Engineering, and escalate to an NCMR when required

• Investigate and solve issues arising in the production as part of a team responsible for complaint investigations

• Suggest corrective and preventive actions based on detailed engineering analysis and review using various root-cause analysis tools and techniques

• Monitor and analyze yield and manufacturing performance metrics, identify trends and improvement opportunities, and translate data into concise management insights

• Drive continuous and measurable process improvements using Operational Excellence (OPEX) methodologies and tools

• Perform change management in our Product Lifecycle System (PLM) Windchill and provide training to the affected audience accordingly

• Support Audit activities as subject matter expert

Your profile:

• B.Sc./M.Sc. in Electrical, Mechanical or Industrial Engineering (Uni, FH, or comparable education)

• 0-3 years of professional experience preferably in MedTech-environment

• A highly curious and proactive learner

• Conscientious, well-structured and independent way of working

• Strong service orientation with a proactive mindset and a passion for supporting manufacturing operations

• Advanced German and English language skills

• Driving continuous improvement and enjoy working in a team

• Knowledge of the regulations applicable in medical technology (ISO 13485 / FDA 21CFR Part 820 / GxP) is a benefit

We are offering opportunities for development for a highly motivated specialist who thinks along and enjoys being part of a small, young team with broad responsibilities. Do you have what it takes? Then send us your application including motivation, curriculum vitae, letter of recommendation and diplomas in PDF format today. We are looking forward to meeting you.

The base pay for this position is
N/A In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

DESCRIZIONE: Thoratec Svizzera GmbH fa parte di Abbott Laboratories, uno dei principali produttori mondiali di dispositivi medici. Siamo il leader del mercato globale per le pompe di sangue impiantabili e extracorporee basate sulla tecnologia di levitazione magnetica. I nostri sistemi salvavita, che sviluppiamo e produciamo a Zurigo, sono utilizzati per la terapia acuta e a lungo termine in pazienti con gravi malattie cardiache. La nostra posizione nella città di Zurigo ha circa 150 dipendenti nelle aree di sviluppo e produzione del sistema Centri MagTM e del motore HeartMate 3TM. Mentre cresciamo il nostro attuale Team, stiamo cercando una persona appassionata, aperta e verso la terra per unirsi al nostro Team. Ingegnere di produzione – Supporto linea Manufacturing Engineering è responsabile del supporto e dell'ottimizzazione della produzione. In qualità di Ingegnere di Supporto Line, servite come punto di contatto primario per risolvere i problemi di produzione, guidando la rapida risoluzione dei problemi, indagando le deviazioni e mantenendo operazioni lisce e conformi in stretta collaborazione con i team interfunzionali. Ti impegni a garantire operazioni di produzione ininterrotte e a consentire al team di produzione di mantenere l'output in modo sicuro, efficiente e nel rispetto dei requisiti di qualità. Lo farai:
• Fornire supporto di primo livello per il piano di produzione in caso di problemi tecnici, assicurando che la produzione possa continuare con un minimo disordine
• Indagare e valutare le deviazioni di produzione (Event Descriptions), determinare la disposizione del materiale in collaborazione con Quality Engineering, ed escalare ad un NCMR quando necessario
• Indagare e risolvere i problemi derivanti dalla produzione come parte di un team responsabile delle indagini sui reclami
• Suggerisci azioni correttive e preventive basate sull'analisi dettagliata dell'ingegneria e sulla revisione utilizzando vari strumenti e tecniche di analisi a causa delle radici
• Monitorare e analizzare le metriche di rendimento e produzione, identificare le tendenze e le opportunità di miglioramento, e tradurre i dati in insight di gestione concise
• Miglioramento del processo continuo e misurabile utilizzando metodologie e strumenti Operazionali Excellence (OPEX)
• Eseguire la gestione dei cambiamenti nel nostro Product Lifecycle System (PLM) Windchill e fornire formazione al pubblico interessato di conseguenza
• Supporto Attività Audit come esperto di materia Il tuo profilo:
• B.Sc./M.Sc. in Ingegneria elettrica, meccanica o industriale (Uni, FH, o formazione comparabile)
• 0-3 anni di esperienza professionale preferibilmente in MedTech-ambiente
• Un apprendimento altamente curioso e proattivo
• Modo di lavoro coscienzioso, ben strutturato e indipendente
• Forte orientamento al servizio con una mentalità proattiva e una passione per sostenere le operazioni di produzione
• Avanzate competenze linguistiche in tedesco e inglese
• Guidare il miglioramento continuo e godere di lavorare in un team
• La conoscenza delle normative applicabili nella tecnologia medica (ISO 13485 / FDA 21CFR Parte 820 / GxP) è un vantaggio Stiamo offrendo opportunità di sviluppo per uno specialista altamente motivato che pensa insieme e gode di essere parte di un piccolo, giovane squadra con ampie responsabilità. Hai quello che serve? Quindi inviaci la tua domanda tra cui motivazione, curriculum vitae, lettera di raccomandazione e diplomi in formato PDF oggi. Non vediamo l'ora di incontrarvi. Il pagamento base per questa posizione è N/A In posizioni specifiche, l'intervallo di pagamento può variare dall'intervallo pubblicato. jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Senior NPI Engineer – New Product Introduction

Abbott is seeking a Senior New Product Introduction (NPI) Engineer to support the development and manufacturing scale ‑ up of the next ‑ generation CentriMag Circulatory Support System . This role will be a key contributor to transitioning complex, electromechanical medical devices from design through validated manufacturing—both in ‑ house and at external suppliers .

The ideal candidate brings hands ‑ on experience in process development , process validation , and manufacturing readiness for capital equipment containing electronics, displays, user interfaces (buttons, touchscreens, connectors), and electromagnetic motors , within a regulated medical device environment.

With your work, you’ll ensure these life-saving products stay at the forefront of innovation and meet the highest standards of our industry. In your role you will be interfacing and collaborating with cross-functional teams in Zurich and United States offices.

Main Responsibilities

New Product Introduction & Process Development

• Drive manufacturing process development from early design phases through commercial launch for complex electro‑mechanical medical devices.

• Develop, characterize, and optimize manufacturing processes for capital equipment, including assembly, test, calibration, and packaging operations.

• Support Design for Manufacturability (DFM) activities in collaboration with R&D, Quality, and Operations.

• Translate design requirements into manufacturing requirements, equipment specifications, and process documentation.

Process Validation & Manufacturing Readiness

• Own process validation activities (IQ/OQ/PQ) for in‑house equipment and supplier processes in compliance with ISO 13485 and Abbott procedures.

• Author validation plans, protocols, and summary reports.

• Create manufacturing documentation, including manufacturing requirements, equipment and process specifications, manufacturing procedures/work instructions/IPCs, test methods, and PFMEAs.

Manufacturing & Supplier Collaboration

• Serve as the technical interface between Abbott and external suppliers developing sub‑assemblies or performing outsourced manufacturing steps.

• Review supplier process flows, PFMEAs, control plans, and validation protocols.

• Align internal and external manufacturing processes for efficient production.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• 5+ years of experience in medical device NPI, manufacturing engineering, or process development.

• Ownership in developing and validating manufacturing processes and tooling for electro‑mechanical or capital medical equipment.

• Strong working knowledge of process validation (IQ/OQ/PQ) and regulated manufacturing environments.

• Experience creating manufacturing requirements, specifications, and procedures, including developing/defining CTQs and IPCs

• Hands-on experience on the manufacturing floor to support engineering/pilot builds.

• Experience collaborating with and managing external suppliers for manufacturing processes or sub‑assemblies.

• Strong technical writing and communication skills; ability to collaborate with a cross-functional project team (R&D, Quality, Regulatory, etc.)

• English proficiency is required (English is used in meetings and all documentation)

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with medical devices/equipment containing electronics, motors, LCD displays, and user interface components

• Proficiency using statistics, including gage R&R, DOE, capability studies (Cp/Cpk), and other analyses to ensure measurement and process robustness

• Experience with Lean Manufacturing and/or Six Sigma methodologies

• Experience supporting production ramp‑up and sustaining engineering after product launch

• Sustaining experience post-launch, e.g. yield improvement, root cause investigations, and

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Thoratec Switzerland GmbH is a part of Abbott Laboratories , one of the world's leading manufacturers of medical devices. We are the global market leader for implantable and extracorporeal blood pumps based on magnetic levitation technology. Our life-saving systems, which we develop and manufacture in Zurich, are used for acute and long-term therapy in patients with severe heart diseases.

Our location in the city of Zurich has around 130 employees in the areas of development and production of the Centri MagTM system and the HeartMate 3TM motor.

As we grow our current team, we are looking for a passionate, open minded and down to earth person to join our team.

(Senior) Electrical Engineer

The open position is within the Manufacturing Engineering – Equipment Engineering team. The Equipment Engineering team works together with Maintenance Engineering and First Level Support teams to assure availability and compliance of our Test Equipment.

In this function you will:

• Be responsible to build and qualify Electrical Test Equipment to assure production continuity

• Depending on priorities, responsible to design new Electrical Test Equipment, conducting Equipment/Non-product Software and Test Method validation activities

• Take ownership for equipment availability and repair

• Support the whole equipment lifecycle

• Support equipment related corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities

Desired Profile:

• Background: Electrical Engineering

• 3+ experience as an electrical engineer preferable

• Good knowledge of electrical circuit design

• Experience in trouble-shooting electrical equipment

• Software knowhow, at best C# and Python, experience with OpenHTF is a plus

• Experience with debugging Software

• Experience with EIQ/EOQ & NPS validation is an asset

• Fluent in English (written and spoken), German would be an asset

We are offering opportunities for development for a highly motivated specialist who thinks along and enjoys being part of a small, young team with broad responsibilities. Do you have what it takes? Then send us your application including motivation, curriculum vitae, letter of recommendation and diplomas in PDF format today. We are looking forward to meeting you.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Zurich, Switzerland | Thoratec Switzerland GmbH (Abbott)

At Thoratec Switzerland GmbH , part of Abbott’s medical device division, we design and manufacture life‑saving heart pump systems used by patients with advanced heart failure around the world. Our products — including CentriMag and HeartMate 3 — are developed and produced at our Zurich site and support patients every day in critical care settings.

With around 140 colleagues across Development, Quality, and Production, our Zurich site combines deep technical expertise with a strong sense of purpose and teamwork. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a EHS Specialist who enjoys collaboration, learning, and leading with care , while contributing to work that truly makes a difference.

About The Role

The EHS Specialist will be responsible for implementing internal and external standards regarding environment, health and safety as well as physical security. The successful candidate will continuously monitor, report, sustain, update and implement new requirements and represent the site’s program to auditors and government officials. In this cross-functional role, you’ll report into the plants head of operations and collaborate with a global EHS team.

Key Responsibilities:

• Ensure accurate and timely reporting of site EHS metrics.

• Develop and lead onsite Emergency Response programs.

• Adapt and rollout global EHS training programs.

• Ensure EHS documentation is accurate and compliant to internal standards and Swiss laws and regulations.

• Act as the point of contact for EHS matters at Abbott Heart Failure’s Zurich site.

• Support Company initiatives as identified by management and in support of Safety Management Systems, Environmental Management Systems (EMS), and other regulatory requirements.

• Promote work safety on site and act as Spezialisten der Arbeitssicherheit (ASA) and facilitate periodic safety audits.

• Organize and manage compliance with Abbott EHS standards via assessment of site programs and documents

• Incorporate duties of a Swiss SiBe (Sicherheitsbeauftragter)

• Work as a team player on a global EHS team

Required Qualifications/Technical Skills:

• Bachelor/Master’s degree in a Science or Engineering discipline

• Professional certification preferred including Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH), ISO14001 Lead Auditor

• Min. 3 years of experience in EHS Management ideally in a global, American corporation

• Able to work in a matrix environment with little supervision

• Experience within Med-Tech or pharmaceutical industry desired

• Efficient hands-on project experience, able to get things done

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to adapt it to all levels

• Structured, rigorous and analytical approach

• Excellent command of English with German proficiency preferred, both written and spoken.

Reporting/Supervisory Structure:

• The role reports directly to the Director of Site Operations with a dotted line to the Division Environmental Health and Safety Leader.

Why Join Abbott / Thoratec?

At Abbott, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, respected, and able to grow . You can expect:

• Work that directly improves and saves lives

• Long‑term career development in a global healthcare organization

• A stable, crisis‑resilient industry

• A collaborative, international, and highly skilled team

• A modern workplace in the heart of Zurich

• An inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are valued

Apply via:
Abbott Jobs | Apply Now | Abbott Laboratories Careers

The base pay for this position is
N/A In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Abbott ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Gesundheitswesen, das bahnbrechende wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse nutzt und Lösungen zur Verbesserung der Gesundheit der Menschen entwickelt. Wir blicken stets in die Zukunft und antizipieren Veränderungen in der medizinischen Wissenschaft und Technologie.

ARBEITEN BEI ABBOTT
Bei Abbott finden Sie eine Aufgabe, die von Bedeutung ist, und können sich weiterentwickeln und lernen, für sich und Ihre Familie sorgen, sich selbst verwirklichen und ein erfülltes Leben führen. Abbott bietet Ihnen:

• Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem internationalen Unternehmen, in dem Sie die Karriere machen können, von der Sie träumen

• Eine herausfordernde Position in einer schnell wachsenden krisenunabhängigen Branche

• Teil eines dynamischen, hochqualifizierten und motivierten Teams zu werden

• Flache Hierarchien, offene, wertschätzende Mentalität und effiziente, konstruktive Kommunikationswege

• Ein multinationales Umfeld, in dem wir die Entwicklung unserer Talente innerhalb des Unternehmens fördern

• Ein Unternehmen, das als eine der Best Big Companies to Work For anerkannt ist, sowie als bester Arbeitsplatz für Vielfalt, arbeitende Mütter, weibliche Führungskräfte und Wissenschaftler:innen sowie als Top Employer Deutschlands ausgezeichnet wurde

Unser Ziel im Geschäftsbereich Structural Heart ist es, die Gesundheit wiederherzustellen und die Lebensqualität durch die Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von Geräte- und Managementlösungen für die Behandlung von strukturellen Herzerkrankungen zu verbessern.

Zur Stärkung des Schweizer Vertriebsteams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n

Territory Manager Cardiology/LAA Occluder - Region Deutschsprachige Schweiz
home-office based, idealer Wohnort im Gebiet

Der Territory Manager ist für die kommerzielle Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung aller Kunden innerhalb des zugewiesenen Vertriebsgebiets verantwortlich. Ziel der Position ist die Förderung der Nutzung von Cardiac-Occluder-Produkten, die Steigerung des Einsatzes der Intrakardialen Echokardiographie (ICE), das Erreichen der Vertriebsziele sowie die Sicherung und der Ausbau von Marktanteilen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Interventionskardiologen, Elektrophysiologen und relevanten Ansprechpartnern in Kliniken identifiziert und entwickelt der Territory Manager Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, unterstützt klinische Eingriffe und trägt zur Optimierung der Behandlungsergebnisse bei.
Darüber hinaus fungiert der Territory Manager als zentraler Ansprechpartner für sämtliche kommerziellen und technischen Aktivitäten innerhalb des verantworteten Vertriebsgebiets.

​ IHRE AUFGABEN

• Eigenverantwortliche Betreuung und Entwicklung aller zugeordneten Kunden und Kliniken im Vertriebsgebiet.

• Erreichung der vereinbarten Umsatzziele sowie Ausbau von Marktanteilen.

• Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Account-Plänen zur Steigerung von Prozeduren und Geschäftswachstum.

• Führung von kommerziellen Verhandlungen, Ausschreibungen und Einkaufsprozessen.

• Vertretung und Verteidigung der Preis- und Wertstrategie von Abbott.

• Analyse von Markt- und Wettbewerbsaktivitäten sowie Identifikation neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.

• Aufbau und Pflege nachhaltiger Beziehungen zu relevanten Entscheidungsträgern und Stakeholdern.

• Koordination und Betreuung lokaler Key Opinion Leader (KOLs).

• Förderung der Nutzung von intraprozeduralen Bildgebungslösungen, insbesondere Intrakardialer Echokardiographie (ICE), sowie bildgestützter Arbeitsabläufe.

• Technische und klinische Unterstützung bei Eingriffen mit Cardiac Occludern zur Verschlussbehandlung des linken Vorhofohrs (Left Atrial Appendage Closure/Occlusion).

• Unterstützung der Eingriffsplanung, Fallbesprechungen und klinischen Entscheidungsprozesse.

• Durchführung von Produkt-, Therapie- und Anwendungsschulungen für Ärzte sowie Katheterlabor-Teams.

• Ansprechpartner für klinische und technische Fragestellungen im Bereich kardiale Bildgebung mit Schwerpunk

descriptionByLocale.it:
DESCRIZIONE:
Abbott è leader globale nella sanità, sfruttando la scienza innovativa e sviluppando soluzioni per migliorare la salute delle persone. Guardiamo sempre al futuro e aspettiamo cambiamenti nella scienza medica e nella tecnologia.

FUNZIONE DI LAVORO
A Abbott, troverete un compito che conta, e sarete in grado di evolvere e imparare, prendersi cura di te e della tua famiglia, realizzarsi e vivere una vita soddisfacente. Abbott ti offre:

• Opportunità di sviluppo in una società internazionale in cui si può fare la carriera si sogno

• Una posizione impegnativa in un settore in crisi in rapida crescita

• Diventa parte di un team dinamico, altamente qualificato e motivato

• Gerarchie piatte, mentalità aperta, apprezzativa e canali di comunicazione efficienti e costruttivi

• Un ambiente multinazionale in cui promuoviamo lo sviluppo dei nostri talenti all'interno dell'azienda

• Una società riconosciuta come una delle migliori grandi aziende per lavorare, così come il miglior posto di lavoro per la diversità, madri di lavoro, leader femminili e scienziati, nonché il primo datore di lavoro in Germania

Il nostro obiettivo nel cuore strutturale è quello di ripristinare la salute e migliorare la qualità della vita sviluppando e fornendo soluzioni di dispositivo e gestione per il trattamento della malattia cardiaca strutturale.

Per rafforzare il team di vendita svizzero, stiamo cercando un

Territorio Manager Cardiologia/LAA Occluder - Regione Svizzera tedesca
sede-ufficio, luogo ideale per vivere nella zona

Il Territorio Manager è responsabile del supporto commerciale e dello sviluppo di tutti i clienti all'interno dell'area di vendita assegnata. L'obiettivo della posizione è quello di promuovere l'uso dei prodotti Cardiac Occluder, aumentare l'uso dell'ecocardiografia Intracardiac (ICE), raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita e garantire e ampliare la quota di mercato. In stretta collaborazione con cardiologi interventistici, elettrofisiologi e contatti rilevanti nelle cliniche, il Territorio Manager identifica e sviluppa opportunità di business, supporta interventi clinici e contribuisce all'ottimizzazione dei risultati del trattamento.
Inoltre, il Territorio Manager funge da punto di contatto centrale per tutte le attività commerciali e tecniche nell'area di vendita responsabile.

ITS TASKs

• Supporto e sviluppo auto-responsabili di tutti i clienti e le cliniche assegnate nell'area di vendita.

• Realizzazione degli obiettivi di vendita concordati e espansione delle quote di mercato.

• Sviluppo e attuazione dei piani di conto per aumentare le procedure e la crescita aziendale.

• condurre negoziati commerciali, offerte e processi di acquisto.

• Rappresentare e difendere la strategia di prezzi e valore di Abbott.

• Analisi del mercato e attività competitive, nonché identificazione di nuove opportunità di business.

• Costruire e mantenere relazioni sostenibili con i responsabili decisionali e gli stakeholder rilevanti.

• Coordinamento e supervisione dei Leader locali del parere chiave (KOL).

• Promuovere l'uso di soluzioni di imaging intraprocedurale, in particolare l'ecocardiografia intracardiac (ICE) e i flussi di lavoro basati sull'immagine.

• Supporto tecnico e clinico per le procedure con Cardiac Occluders per il trattamento di chiusura dell'appendice atriale sinistro chiusura/occlusione.

• Sostenere la pianificazione degli interventi, le discussioni sui casi e i processi decisionali clinici.

• Attuazione di prodotto, terapia e formazione di applicazione per medici e team di laboratorio di catetere.

• Contatto per problemi clinici e tecnici nel campo dell'imaging cardiaco con enfasi
descriptionByLocale.en:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Abbott is a global leader in healthcare, leveraging groundbreaking science and developing solutions to improve people’s health. We always look to the future and anticipate changes in medical science and technology.

FUNCTIONING WORK
At Abbott, you’ll find a task that matters, and you’ll be able to evolve and learn, take care of yourself and your family, realize yourself and live a fulfilling life. Abbott offers you:

• Development opportunities in an international company where you can make the career you dream of

• A challenging position in a rapidly growing crisis-independent industry

• Become part of a dynamic, highly qualified and motivated team

• Flat hierarchies, open, appreciative mentality and efficient, constructive communication channels

• A multinational environment where we promote the development of our talents within the company

• A company that is recognized as one of the Best Big Companies to Work For, as well as the best workplace for diversity, working mothers, female leaders and scientists, as well as the top employer in Germany

Our goal in Structural Heart is to restore health and improve quality of life by developing and delivering device and management solutions for the treatment of structural heart disease.

To strengthen the Swiss sales team, we are looking for a

Territory Manager Cardiology/LAA Occluder - Region German-speaking Switzerland
home-office based, ideal place to live in the area

The Territory Manager is responsible for the commercial support and development of all customers within the assigned sales area. The aim of the position is to promote the use of Cardiac Occluder products, increase the use of Intracardiac Echocardiography (ICE), achieve sales objectives and secure and expand market share. In close cooperation with interventional cardiologists, electrophysiologists and relevant contacts in clinics, the Territory Manager identifies and develops business opportunities, supports clinical interventions and contributes to the optimization of treatment outcomes.
In addition, the Territory Manager acts as the central point of contact for all commercial and technical activities within the responsible sales area.

ITS TASKS

• Self-responsible support and development of all assigned customers and clinics in the sales area.

• Achievement of the agreed sales targets and expansion of market shares.

• Development and implementation of account plans to increase procedures and business growth.

• conduct commercial negotiations, tenders and purchasing processes.

• Representing and defending Abbott’s pricing and value strategy.

• Analysis of market and competitive activities as well as identification of new business opportunities.

• Build and maintain sustainable relationships with relevant decision-makers and stakeholders.

• Coordination and supervision of local Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).

• Promote the use of intraprocedural imaging solutions, in particular intracardiac echocardiography (ICE) and image-based workflows.

• Technical and clinical support for procedures with Cardiac Occluders for the closure treatment of the left atrial appendage closure/occlusion.

• Support intervention planning, case discussions and clinical decision-making processes.

• Implementation of product, therapy and application training for doctors and catheter laboratory teams.

• Contact for clinical and technical issues in the field of cardiac imaging with emphasis
descriptionByLocale.fr:
DESCRIPTION DE L'EMPLOI :
Abbott est un leader mondial dans le domaine des soins de santé, en tirant parti de la science révolutionnaire et en développant des solutions pour améliorer la santé des gens. Nous nous tournons toujours vers l'avenir et anticipons les changements dans les sciences et la technologie médicales.

FONCTIONNEMENT
Chez Abbott, vous trouverez une tâche qui compte, et vous pourrez évoluer et apprendre, prendre soin de vous et de votre famille, vous réaliser et vivre une vie épanouissante. Abbott vous offre :

• Possibilités de développement dans une entreprise internationale où vous pouvez faire la carrière que vous rêvez de

• Une position stimulante dans une industrie indépendante de crise en croissance rapide

• Devenez membre d'une équipe dynamique, hautement qualifiée et motivée

• Hiérarchies plates, mentalité ouverte, appréciatrice et canaux de communication efficaces et constructifs

• Un environnement multinational où nous favorisons le développement de nos talents au sein de l'entreprise

• Une entreprise reconnue comme l'une des meilleures grandes entreprises à travailler pour, ainsi que le meilleur lieu de travail pour la diversité, les mères qui travaillent, les dirigeantes et les scientifiques, ainsi que le meilleur employeur en Allemagne

Notre objectif en Cœur Structurel est de rétablir la santé et d'améliorer la qualité de vie en développant et en fournissant des solutions d'appareillage et de gestion pour le traitement des maladies cardiaques structurelles.

Pour renforcer l'équipe commerciale suisse, nous recherchons

Territorial Manager Cardiology/LAA Occluder - Région Suisse alémanique
maison-bureau, endroit idéal pour vivre dans la région

Le gestionnaire du territoire est responsable du soutien commercial et du développement de tous les clients dans la zone de vente assignée. L'objectif de la position est de promouvoir l'utilisation des produits d'occluder cardiaque, d'accroître l'utilisation de l'échocardiographie intracardiaque (ICE), d'atteindre les objectifs de vente et de sécuriser et d'accroître la part de marché. En étroite collaboration avec les cardiologues interventionnels, les électrophysiologues et les contacts pertinents dans les cliniques, le gestionnaire du territoire identifie et développe des possibilités d'affaires, appuie les interventions cliniques et contribue à l'optimisation des résultats du traitement.
En outre, le gestionnaire du territoire est le point de contact central pour toutes les activités commerciales et techniques dans la zone de vente responsable.

SES TÂCHES

• Soutien et développement auto-responsables de tous les clients et cliniques affectés dans la zone de vente.

• Réalisation des objectifs de vente convenus et augmentation des parts de marché.

• Élaboration et mise en oeuvre de plans de compte pour accroître les procédures et la croissance des entreprises.

• mener des négociations commerciales, des appels d'offres et des processus d'achat.

• Représentation et défense de la stratégie de prix et de valeur d'Abbott.

• Analyse des activités commerciales et concurrentielles et identification de nouvelles opportunités commerciales.

• Établir et maintenir des relations durables avec les décideurs et les intervenants concernés.

• Coordination et supervision des chefs d'opinion clés locaux.

• Promouvoir l'utilisation de solutions d'imagerie intraprocédurale, en particulier l'échocardiographie intracardiatique (ICE) et les flux de travail basés sur l'image.

• Soutien technique et clinique pour les procédures avec les Occlusions Cardiaques pour le traitement de la fermeture de l'appendice auriculaire gauche fermeture/occlusion.

• Appuyer la planification des interventions, les discussions de cas et les processus décisionnels cliniques.

• Mise en place d'une formation sur les produits, les thérapies et les applications pour les médecins et les équipes de laboratoire de cathéter.

• Contact pour les questions cliniques et techniques dans le domaine de l'imagerie cardiaque avec accent
